descriptions.pretokenization: maximal Unicode whitespace runs or non-whitespace runs; never merge across runs
descriptions.pair_tie_break: lexicographic tuple (left raw bytes, right raw bytes), unsigned byte order
descriptions.merged_symbol_identity: identical raw byte sequence reuses a token ID; new IDs assigned in first-creation order
descriptions.training_occurrences: count all adjacent pairs in the current sequence, then replace selected pair non-overlapping left-to-right
descriptions.training_maintenance: after one initial scan, update occurrence positions and weighted pair counts only around actual replacements; invalidated candidate/occurrence entries must not affect later decisions
